headline: CONMAT’s GEL spikes 25% on an open price gap, while PROP’s PF tumbles 20% on elevated volume.
market_take: Today's coverage shows a mixed picture with standout moves in CONMAT and PROP. GEL surged 25% on a price gap despite low volume, whereas PF fell 20% on a modest volume increase. Several securities posted extreme volume spikes, notably CMC (31σ) and TKN (5.8σ), while a handful of stocks opened with -100% gaps, hinting at possible trading halts.

sector_notes.note: GEL jumped +25.00% on an open price gap; PPP added +4.41% with modest volume.
PF dropped -20.00% on volume ×1.15; A fell -13.86%; JCK opened -8.33%; CMC rose +7.50% with a 31.0σ volume spike; PRIN posted an intraday +7.41% move.

CHOTI opened with a -100.00% gap; SNP and TFMAMA recorded volume spikes of 7.0σ and 4.5σ respectively; NRF fell -4.55% on a 6.5σ volume spike; TKN rose +4.23% on a 5.8σ volume spike and filed a share‑repurchase notice.
MNIT2 showed a 9.8σ volume spike; LHRREIT and QHBREIT disclosed capital reductions.
PLE surged +16.67% intraday; SQ slipped -5.56%; APCS gained +4.90%.
